extractedText: 06.04.2026 464 2 min Anthropic to Form Its Own Political Action Committee Amid a Clash With Trump Sergey Khukharkin Поділитися в Telegram Поділитися в Twitter Копіювати посилання Anthropic filed an application to set up a political action committee (PAC). Most major tech companies have organizations like this. They fund individual politicians, effectively lobbying for a particular policy direction. The company took this step amid a conflict with the Trump administration. AI company Anthropic, the developer of Claude, filed an application with the U.S. Federal Election Commission (FEC) to establish AnthroPAC. It is a political committee focused on raising funds and supporting specific candidates. According to OpenSecrets, PACs in the U.S. often represent the interests of businesses, labor unions, and ideological groups. These are nonprofit organizations whose entire activity is focused on attracting donations and distributing them to candidates who advance the ideas of a particular committee. PACs also play a significant role in shaping the political landscape in the U.S. For example, the committee backing current U.S. President Donald Trump raised $102 million from counterparties in the AI and cryptoasset sectors in the second half of 2025 alone. According to Bloomberg, Anthropic’s PAC will be funded through voluntary employee donations, capped at $5,000 per person per year. Which politicians the company will support through its committee is unknown at the time of writing. Meanwhile, tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon have their own PACs. According to OpenSecrets, in 2024, these three committees alone donated a combined $2.3 million, mostly to Republicans. Conflict With the Trump Administration Anthropic filed its PAC application amid issues with the current administration. The company was added to a “blacklist” for refusing to provide full access to Claude. It is now trying to challenge that decision in court. At the same time, according to media reports, the firm is preparing for a listing. Experts believe that the ongoing conflict with the Trump administration could lead Anthropic to choose another market for its initial public offering. In these circumstances, the creation of a PAC can be seen as an attempt to influence the political landscape in the US. Published: 06.04.2026
